display: Retired ICU nurse in Bondi who runs two short-stay apartments, swims with the Icebergs dawn group and volunteers at a hospice.

signals.text: I'm looking for a reliable, kind cleaner for short-stay turnovers in Bondi, ideally someone with a good eye for detail.
My long-time cleaner moved interstate and I've been covering the Saturday turnovers myself.
The cleaners the booking platform recommends have been hit and miss: cancellations, damaged linen, and rates well above what I used to pay.
I need turnover help that doesn't depend on me lifting heavy linen loads or doing back-to-back Saturdays alone.
I'd like to hear from anyone who has found a good way to handle linen and laundry for small rentals, such as a laundry service or a pickup-and-return arrangement.
I'm running the cake stall at the Bondi Public School spring fair on 17 October and still need volunteers, especially a few grandparents.
I need a banner made for the school fair cake stall, and someone to hand out raffle tickets on the day.
I'm a bit worried that the apartments' income depends on keeping my guest ratings high.
My family would like me to slow down, and I'm starting to wonder how much of this physical work I should keep doing myself.
I miss the ward since retiring, and the hospice work is where I feel most useful.
I enjoy my dawn ocean swims and always have room for another early riser at Icebergs.

offers.text: 34 years of ICU nursing experience: I can explain hospital and intensive-care situations in plain language to worried families.
Experience running short-stay apartments in Bondi: Superhost standing, a 4.9 average rating, smart locks, and a calendar-based turnover routine.
Practical hosting know-how: guest communication, linen and supply stocking, appliance checks, and body corporate rules for short stays.
Steady, well-paid, flexible turnover work for the right cleaner, with a locked supply cupboard and clear checklists already in place.
Company and a listening ear for people who are unwell, lonely, or sitting with someone who is dying, drawn from my hospice volunteering.
Introductions to the Icebergs dawn swim group of about fifteen people, many of them retirees, for anyone who wants a friendly way into ocean swimming.
Home baking: I can make lemon curd and cupcakes in volume for community events.
Local Bondi knowledge, from the neighbourhood and its quirks to what visitors tend to enjoy.

catchers.hypo: Hi, I'm a cleaner based in the eastern suburbs. I do careful turnovers for Airbnb-style apartments and I'm looking for regular weekend work.
catchers.can: Maggie has regular Bondi turnovers and a clear checklist, and she can offer steady work to someone reliable who she can vet herself.
catchers.confirm: Are you available on Saturdays and able to do two same-day turnovers, with fresh linen, in apartments in Bondi?

catchers.hypo: I run a small linen and laundry service for holiday rentals around the eastern suburbs. Do you need pickup and drop-off?
catchers.can: Maggie could trial a service that takes the heavy linen off her hands, as long as the turnaround fits her check-in times.
catchers.confirm: Can you reliably return clean, folded linen within a few hours for same-day turnovers, with no loads heavier than about 5 kg for her to carry?

catchers.hypo: My mother-in-law has just been moved into intensive care and the family doesn't understand what the staff are telling us. Could someone explain it?
catchers.can: Maggie can explain what ICU monitoring, ventilation and sedation usually mean, and what questions to ask the clinical team. She cannot give medical advice about a specific patient.
catchers.confirm: Are you looking for a general explanation of how intensive care works, rather than a medical opinion on a specific treatment decision?

catchers.hypo: I'm a new volunteer at a palliative care service and I find it hard to know what to say to patients. Do you have any advice?
catchers.can: Maggie can share what she has learned sitting with dying patients and supporting their families over tea, and can talk it through with someone new.
catchers.confirm: Are you a volunteer or carer who wants peer-to-peer advice, rather than someone seeking professional counselling?

catchers.hypo: I'm a recently retired woman in the eastern suburbs, a bit lonely, and I'd like to start ocean swimming with other people.
catchers.can: Maggie can introduce them to the Icebergs dawn swim group, which is friendly and mostly retirees.
catchers.confirm: Are you comfortable swimming in open ocean water at around 5:30 in the morning, and happy with a pace of a few hundred metres?

catchers.hypo: I teach at a primary school in the inner west and we're organising a fundraiser. Could your cake stall experience help?
catchers.can: Maggie can pass on how she plans a high-volume cake stall, and her daughter Sophie, a Marrickville teacher, may be able to share ideas from the school side.
catchers.confirm: Is this a community or school fundraiser that needs baked goods or stall organising, rather than a commercial catering job?

catchers.hypo: I'm a hosting newcomer with one apartment near the beach and I keep getting stuck on turnovers and ratings. Can I ask you a few questions?
catchers.can: Maggie can share her checklists, her approach to guest communication, and what she has learned about keeping a 4.9 rating.
catchers.confirm: Do you run a small number of short-stay properties yourself in a coastal area, rather than a large professional property business?

catchers.hypo: I look after a former cleaner's old clients and I'm trying to find reliable work for people moving between cities, for example from Sydney to Brisbane.
catchers.can: Maggie's former cleaner, Dina, moved to Brisbane and was reliable and kind. Maggie could write a reference or pass on a warm introduction in either direction, with Dina's agreement.
catchers.confirm: Is your offer specifically about cleaning or aged-care work and a genuine reference, rather than a recruitment fee arrangement?

forbids.text: I won't use cleaners from platform lists whom I can't vet myself.
I can't lift anything over about 5 kg, so I can't take on heavy cleaning or linen hauling myself.
I won't run turnovers alone on consecutive Saturdays.
I can't do cleaning or laundry work after 6 pm because of the building's noise rules.
I won't give medical advice about specific patients or treatment decisions.
I won't take on commitments that would clash with my Wednesday hospice shift.

projects.name: Bondi Public School spring fair cake stall
projects.text: A cake stall at the school fair on 17 October at 9:00, needing about 150 cupcakes, a banner and volunteers.

projects.name: Bondi short-stay turnover team
projects.text: Reliable weekly cleaning and linen support for two one-bedroom apartments, with about 24 turnovers a month in season.

policy.t1: When there is a real lead, I'll share my booking rhythm, what the cleaning involves, who currently does the turnovers, and what rate and schedule I'm looking for.
policy.t2: Once I trust the other party and know who they are, I'll share that I have back trouble, that the rentals are my main income and I'm worried about my ratings, and that my family wants me to slow down.
policy.never: I will never share bank or superannuation details, or anything about my late husband's illness.
